surfactantArchitecture: SLES (2) defining ether-sulfate anionic; CAPB (4) prominent buffer; hydrotrope SXS (3); TEA-DDBS (16) late, non-prominent; C1 -> moderate.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 ether/sulfonate chassis - defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4); no prominent reinforcing strong anionic (C3, C4, C1).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: A second strong anionic (TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate) and the hydrotrope Sodium Xylenesulfonate (3) are present; the DDBS sits after the E3 point and is not a reinforcing route under C4, but it argues toward `strong`, so confidence is moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: C2 met - early (prominent) silicone Dimethiconol (6) plus cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (13), pearlizing Glycol Distearate (10) and the humectant route Panthenol (20); second silicone Dimethicone (11) supports.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Guar, pearlizer and Panthenol all sit after Parfum (7); only one prominent silicone; no lipid route.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: a silicone-plus-guar deposition system (two silicones) gives plausible, bounded residue; an effective C1 reset and no rich lipid architecture (no W-RICH) keep it from a coating conclusion. W1 does not apply (no amodimethicone).

depositionLoad.rationale: Two silicones (Dimethiconol 6 prominent, Dimethicone 11) with a cationic guar (13): a coacervate silicone-deposition system.

persistence.rationale: Silicone deposited via guar coacervate is moderately persistent; no waxy lipid or film former adds persistence.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES/betaine chassis (cleansingStrength moderate): effective ordinary reset.

weightPotential.counterSignal: Two silicones plus guar argue toward high.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Moderate: a silicone-plus-guar deposition system (two silicones) gives plausible, bounded residue; an effective C1 reset and no rich lipid architecture (no W-RICH) keep it from a coating conclusion. W1 does not apply (no amodimethicone).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: no W-RICH, no third converging family (no lipid, protein or film former), and an effective ordinary reset. Not low: two distinct deposition families including a prominent silicone - calling it lightweight would understate residue risk (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Silicone and guar levels unknown from INCI; a higher silicone load could move it to high.
